lines.en: I hang in the air and slide slowly sideways.

lines.zh: 四片薄翅，扇得没有声音。
lines.en: Four thin wings, beating silently.
I pass through the overgrowth canopy.

lines.zh: 我翅上那层薄膜，是半透明的。
lines.en: The membrane on my wings is half-transparent.
I keep at the height of a person.

lines.zh: 风把我推歪，我修正回来。
lines.en: The wind nudges me off. I correct.
I drift toward my kin.
The edges of my wings are sharp.

lines.zh: 我悬在蔓生林上方，翅膀薄。
lines.en: I hover over the overgrowth on thin wings.
I drop a little to clear the branches.

lines.zh: 我缓慢地滑行，不用着急。
lines.en: I glide slowly. No need to rush.
I fly along the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 身后有一道很细的气流。
lines.en: A fine wake of air trails behind me.

lines.zh: 叶片嗡嗡响，我循声过去。
lines.en: My leaves hum; I follow the sound.
I hover, wings almost still.
Sunlight passes through my wings.
I don't start trouble.
I'm watching who moves in the wood.
My body's light. The wind holds it.
A few of my kin are over there.
I don't need to land.

lines.zh: 我的翅上有一层薄薄的膜。
lines.en: A thin membrane on my wings.
I settle on a branch and fold my leaves.
I turn slowly to look the other way.

lines.zh: 这么飘着，可以飘一整天。
lines.en: I could drift like this all day.
I'm waiting for the wind to ease.

lines.zh: 抬头才看得见，我在上面。
lines.en: Look up — I'm above.
I've no intention of fighting you.
Don't move first. I haven't decided.

lines.zh: 我翅上的边缘，你看见了吗。
lines.en: Do you see the edges of my wings.
We're far enough apart now.
Go on through. I won't stop you.
I'm only watching.

lines.zh: 铁的味道，我的叶片不喜欢。
lines.en: The smell of iron — my leaves dislike it.

lines.zh: 我往后退了退，转了半圈。
lines.en: I drift back and half-turn away.
Still, that doesn't make you an enemy.
My wing has crumpled.
I drop a little, then recover.
This much just makes me fly crooked.
I withdraw into the canopy.

lines.zh: 叶片互相碰响，同伴来了。
lines.en: Leaves click together — the others come.
A hole in the wing membrane.
I beat slowly to stay level.

lines.zh: 叶子边缘卷了，我记住了。
lines.en: A leaf edge curled — I'll remember.
I'm still here. I haven't left.
I'm still up here.
I don't eat that.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我绕着看了看。
lines.en: You hold it up. I circle and look.
There's nothing I need in it.
Drop it on the ground.
My kin are coming over too.
They don't eat it either.
This draws insects.

lines.zh: 那是给虫子的，你收起来。
lines.en: That's for insects. Put it away.

lines.zh: 我们要的是叶子，不是这个。
lines.en: We want leaves, not this.
We don't eat it. Keep it.
You knocked my wing.
I pull back. My wing's crooked.

lines.zh: 这么轻的碰撞，我也受不了。
lines.en: Even a light knock I can't take.

lines.zh: 你抬手的时候，气流把我推开了。
lines.en: When you raised your arm, the air pushed me off.
I brace against a tree.
Don't swing things up here.

lines.zh: 我们擦过，翅边划到你了。
lines.en: We brushed and my wing edge caught you.
That wasn't intended.
I'll climb a little higher.
Then we won't touch again.
We're in the same wood.
You fly steadier than I do.
Hovering side by side isn't very close.
The four of us patrol this stretch.
Our wingbeats slowly sync.

lines.zh: 两只一起转，叶片对上了。
lines.en: Two spin together, leaves aligned.
If there's danger, I'll call.
You'll hear it.
When the wind's strong, keep to my side.
We'll always meet above the wood.
I flick it with a wingtip.
Too heavy to carry.
I'll keep this leaf.
It falls. I don't go after it.
Yours. I won't touch it.
I tuck it under my wing.
That weight doesn't affect flight.
It cut my wing.
One curl of my leaves and I toss it.
This thing's too sharp.

lines.zh: 我把叶片收起来，算你赢一次。
lines.en: I fold my leaves — you win this once.
Then I have to answer.
I turn to face you.
My kin are flying this way too.
Four of us together is enough.

lines.zh: 我降到和你眼睛一样高。
lines.en: I drop to the height of your eyes.
My wing edge points at you.
Step back and I'll stop.
You don't flinch, so I hesitate.
You struck. Fine, then.
Of the four, I go first.
Looking up won't be quick enough.
We come from above.
Spread out. Come from all sides.

lines.zh: 我吊在你头顶，影子很小。
lines.en: I hang overhead, a small shadow.
A kin is at your left.
Another at your right.
We've ringed you. You're in the middle.
I'm in no hurry to descend.
Your hand rises; I rise at once.
Lower it and I come down.
Back and forth will tire you.
We don't tire.
The wind holds us up.
You've backed under a tree.
A tree won't stop me coming from above.
Hover a while more.
Until your arm drops.
When your arm drops. Then.
I sweep down past you.
The wing edge passes. A shallow cut.
I turn back and come again.
A kin mirrors me on the other side.
These wings are sharper than they look.
Guard high and there's still one low.
I keep flying. I don't land.
You'd have to jump to reach me.
A jump leaves you open.
That's what we want.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕，等你自己出错。
lines.en: I circle slowly, waiting for your mistake.
A leaf blade still cuts.

lines.zh: 我从树冠上降下来一点。
lines.en: I descend a little from the canopy.
Four wings spread at once.
Above the overgrowth the wind runs east.
I hover and look over the wood.

lines.zh: 翅上的薄膜在光下发亮。
lines.en: The membranes shine in the light.
My kin rise one after another.
Four of us. Spreading out.
Someone's walking at the wood's edge.
We hold still for now.
Wait. Let him walk in.
My leaves spin and I lift off.
Without a sound.
Fire came near and my wing edge curled.
I fell and struck a branch.
Water on my wings and I can't fly.
The blast threw me into the canopy.

lines.zh: 有东西穿破了我的翅膜。
lines.en: Something pierced my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 那光一闪，我翅上的膜僵了。
lines.en: A flash and my membrane went stiff.
The leaves have withered. Nothing to eat.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整只翻了个身。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I flipped over.

lines.zh: 没有风，我的叶片托不住我。
lines.en: Without wind, my leaves can't hold me.
